title: spawnloot
body: Gives SpawnLoot upon command /spawnloot drops. When you execute the command, it gives a shulker box FULL of rare items, perfect for when making a new world, designed for players who are afraid to lose their precious world just to get these items. While it is still in its first verson, we plan to upload newer versions containing new commands designed to give automatic pvp kits, survival kits, perfect fr dueling with your friend, and just showing off!
